Character Editor

Reshape and recolour a character and see it move straight away. Walk, sprint, dash and attack in the arena while you drag the sliders. The settings can be copied out as text and pasted back in later.

Frames

Columns: standing, then four moments of the walk. Rows: south, west, east, north. Attacks are best judged in the arena.

Arena

Controls

WASD
Move. Hold Shift to sprint
J or Left click
Attack (three-hit combo). Hold to charge a heavy swing
K or Right click
Block
Space
Dash
F
Ranged shot
H
Spawn a bot
